# NEED AN ALERNATIVE ANTIMICROBIAL?

If you cannot use the recommended antimicrobials or you believe another one
would be better for your patient, you can order another drug. Please indicate
the reason you need an alternative drug below.

Allergic to recommended drug(s)

Decreased renal clearance

Liver secretory or metabolic impairment

Drug interaction

Patient has multiple infections requiring antimicrobials

Adjust therapy based on antimicrobial susceptibility

Other adverse drug effect

Other reason

Note: Alternative antimicrobial selections will be reviewed and we may contact
prescribers to learn more about situations that need alternatives, improve the
CDSS, and in some cases offer suggestions.
